episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Heather meets Lali, a survivor of Auschwitz, who tells her his extraordinary life story of love and survival in the concentration camp.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Lali contacts Gita through a risky deal with Baretzki, putting her and their new love in danger.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Lali gets medicine for Gita from Schumann, unaware of the implications for the new tattooist Leon.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Gita pleads for Cilka's help to free Lali from punishment without knowing the cost of her request.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Separated from one another, Gita endures the death march and Lali is captured by Russian soldiers.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: With no idea whether she's alive or dead, Lali escapes and heads to Bratislava to find Gita.
